package measure // import "ubunatic.com/loom/measure"

Package measure exposes Loom's terminal-cell measurement policy to layout
planners and applications without introducing a second width contract.

spec.go provides runtime configuration and override lookups for emoji and
sequence widths.

FUNCTIONS

func ApplyAutoRenderMode(glyph string) string
    ApplyAutoRenderMode transforms a glyph string according to the active
    RenderPath.

func ApplyNonVTEMode(glyph string) string
    ApplyNonVTEMode transforms a glyph string using its authoritative Non-VTE
    mode from the spec.

func ApplyRenderMode(glyph, mode string) string
    ApplyRenderMode transforms a glyph string according to the requested mode.

func ApplyRenderPath(glyph string, path RenderPath) string
    ApplyRenderPath transforms a glyph string according to the requested
    RenderPath.

func ApplyVTEMode(glyph string) string
    ApplyVTEMode transforms a glyph string using its authoritative VTE mode from
    the spec.

func ClusterWidth(cluster string) int
    ClusterWidth returns the visual column width of a single text cluster.

func Clusters(text string) []string
    Clusters returns printable base-rune clusters with combining marks attached.

func ClustersNew(text string) []string
    ClustersNew is the zero-allocation cluster slice scanner.

func ClustersOld(text string) []string
    ClustersOld is the legacy Clusters implementation preserved for comparison.

func DetectZWJMode(input, output *os.File, row int)
    DetectZWJMode probes an interactive terminal after its caller has entered
    raw mode and selected its screen. It is safe to call with non-terminal
    files.

func Fit(text string, width int) string
    Fit returns the longest prefix of text that fits within width terminal
    cells. Terminal styling is stripped; combining marks and wide glyphs are
    never split.

func IsFormatRune(r rune) bool
    IsFormatRune returns true for variation selectors and joiner formatting
    controls.

func JoinsAfterZWJ(r rune) bool
    JoinsAfterZWJ reports whether r may extend a grapheme cluster after a
    zero-width joiner (U+200D). Only printable grapheme starts (letters,
    numbers, punctuation, symbols such as emoji) join. Controls (C0, C1, DEL,
    ESC), spaces, format runes and combining marks end the cluster so they go
    through the normal parser/sanitiser instead of being smuggled into cell text
    and written raw to the terminal.

func LoadEmojiSpec(spec EmojiSpec)
    LoadEmojiSpec installs a validated EmojiSpec into the measurement runtime.

func LoadEmojiSpecYAML(data []byte) error
    LoadEmojiSpecYAML decodes and activates an emoji specification from YAML
    bytes.

func NonVTEMode(glyph string) string
    NonVTEMode returns the authoritative modern Non-VTE / standard rendering
    mode for a glyph from the spec.

func Pad(text string, width int, right bool) string
    Pad extends text to width terminal cells using spaces.

func RenderMode(glyph string, path RenderPath) string
    RenderMode returns the authoritative rendering mode for a glyph for the
    given RenderPath.

func ResetRenderPath()
    ResetRenderPath clears any explicit RenderPath override, reverting to
    autodetection.

func RuneWidth(r rune) int
    RuneWidth returns the visual column width of a single rune.

func SetRenderPath(p RenderPath)
    SetRenderPath sets an explicit override for the active RenderPath.

func StringWidth(text string) int
    StringWidth returns the visible terminal-cell width of text according to
    Loom's rendering policy.

func StringWidthNew(text string) int
    StringWidthNew is the zero-allocation fast path for StringWidth.

func StringWidthOld(text string) int
    StringWidthOld is the legacy StringWidth preserved for fallback and
    comparison.

func Truncate(text string, width int, marker string) string
    Truncate fits text to a terminal-cell budget. Terminal styling is stripped;
    combining marks stay with their base and wide glyphs are never split.

func TruncateLeft(text string, width int, marker string) string
    TruncateLeft fits text to a terminal-cell budget while keeping its trailing
    content. Terminal styling is stripped and wide glyphs are never split.

func VTEMode(glyph string) string
    VTEMode returns the authoritative VTE rendering mode for a glyph from the
    spec.

func ZWJClusterWidth(cluster string) int
    ZWJClusterWidth reports the visible width of a ZWJ sequence under the
    startup terminal probe, with LOOM_ZWJ=join|split taking precedence.


TYPES

type Constraints struct {
	Width  Limit
	Height Limit
}
    Constraints bounds measured outer dimensions. Preferred values are hints;
    Min and Max are hard limits.

func (c Constraints) Validate() error
    Validate checks dimension ordering and rejects ambiguous negative values.

type EmojiOverride struct {
	Glyph      string   `yaml:"glyph"`
	Codepoints []string `yaml:"codepoints"`
	Width      int      `yaml:"width"`
	VTEMode    string   `yaml:"vte_mode,omitempty"`
	NonVTEMode string   `yaml:"non_vte_mode,omitempty"`
	Note       string   `yaml:"note"`
}
    EmojiOverride defines an explicit glyph-to-width mapping.

type EmojiSpec struct {
	VS16DefaultWidth int             `yaml:"vs16_default_width"`
	VS16VTEMode      string          `yaml:"vs16_vte_mode"`
	VS16NonVTEMode   string          `yaml:"vs16_non_vte_mode,omitempty"`
	ZWJDefaultWidth  int             `yaml:"zwj_default_width"`
	FlagDefaultWidth int             `yaml:"flag_default_width"`
	Overrides        []EmojiOverride `yaml:"overrides"`
}
    Package measure defines and loads emoji/sequence specifications. EmojiSpec
    defines specced emoji and sequence width policy.

func ActiveEmojiSpec() EmojiSpec
    ActiveEmojiSpec returns a copy of the active emoji specification.

type Insets struct {
	Top, Right, Bottom, Left int
}
    Insets reserves cells around content. All values must be non-negative.

func (i Insets) Height() int
    Height returns the vertical cells occupied by the insets.

func (i Insets) Width() int
    Width returns the horizontal cells occupied by the insets.

type Limit struct {
	Min       int
	Preferred int
	Max       int
	HasMax    bool
}
    Limit describes a minimum, preferred, and optional maximum dimension.

type RenderPath string
    RenderPath identifies the terminal rendering strategy and width alignment
    profile.

const (
	// RenderPathVTE targets VTE-based terminals (e.g. GNOME Terminal, Tilix, Ptyxis)
	// which render VS16 emojis across 2 cells but only advance the cursor by 1 cell.
	RenderPathVTE RenderPath = "vte"

	// RenderPathStandard targets modern non-VTE / Wayland terminals (e.g. Foot, Alacritty, Kitty, WezTerm, Ghostty)
	// which advance cursor by 2 cells natively for wide emoji.
	RenderPathStandard RenderPath = "standard"

	// RenderPathNonVTE is an alias for RenderPathStandard.
	RenderPathNonVTE RenderPath = "non-vte"
)
func ActiveRenderPath() RenderPath
    ActiveRenderPath returns the currently active RenderPath (either manually
    overridden or autodetected).

func DetectRenderPath() RenderPath
    DetectRenderPath inspects the process environment and terminal variables to
    determine the active RenderPath.

type Size struct {
	Width  int
	Height int
}
    Size describes the visible terminal-cell dimensions of text lines.

func Lines(text string) Size
    Lines returns the visible dimensions of a multi-line string. An empty string
    is one empty line.

func MeasureText(text string, availableWidth int, insets Insets, c Constraints) (Size, error)
    MeasureText returns an outer size satisfying c. availableWidth, when
    positive, is a hard width supplied by a parent planner. Insets are included
    in the returned dimensions.

func TextSize(text string, maxWidth int) Size
    TextSize returns the visible size of text. When maxWidth is positive,
    lines wrap at terminal-cell boundaries; explicit newlines are preserved.
    A wide cluster is kept intact even when it exceeds maxWidth.
